newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Netanyahu's Netherlands visit back on.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu's Netherlands visit back on.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu will hold talks with Dutch Prime Minister Wim Kok on Wednesday during a brief stopover in the Netherlands en route to the United States, Netanyahu's spokesman said on Friday.

Netanyahu's office announced on Thursday the prime minister had cancelled plans to visit the Netherlands on February 12 because of memorial ceremonies for some of the 73 Israeli soldiers killed in an air disaster this week.

But Netanyahu's spokesman issued a subsequent statement saying the Israeli leader would meet Kok, whose country currently holds the European Union presidency, at Amsterdam airport during a refuelling stop.
Netanyahu is due to hold talks with U.S. President Bill Clinton in Washington on Thursday.
